name: Lalueza (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over dark blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lalueza (a cross, chequy and a castle) between three yellow lightning bolts above and two white Maltese crosses below.
history: Municipal flag of Lalueza; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Lalueza arms — cross, chequy and castle
three lightning bolts on the red
two Maltese crosses on the blue
